## Brand Identity
- **Brand Name**: Avirena Jewels
- **Legal Name**: Avirena Jewels Private Limited
- **Tagline**: Timeless Beauty • Uniquely Yours
- **Industry**: Homegrown dailywear fashion jewelry
- **Specialty**: Sculptural dailywear jewelry in anti-tarnish brass with cultured freshwater baroque pearls
- **Based in**: Mumbai, India
- **Website**: https://avirenajewels.com
- **Primary market**: India (INR pricing), ships internationally
- **Contact**: avirenajewels@gmail.com | +91 78238 89290 (WhatsApp)

## Materials & Craftsmanship
1. **Base metal**:
   - High-density brass and durable alloys.
   - This is fashion jewelry. It is **not** solid gold, gold vermeil, or sterling silver, and is not hallmarked to any precious-metal fineness standard.
2. **Finish**:
   - Protective anti-tarnish e-coating in gold-tone, silver-tone, and rose gold-tone.
   - Provides everyday water resistance. Finish longevity varies with wear, skin chemistry, and care.
3. **Skin safety**:
   - Nickel-free, lead-free, and cadmium-free.
   - Earring posts are surgical steel.
4. **Pearls**:
   - Hand-selected cultured freshwater baroque pearls.
   - No simulated resin, plastic, or synthetic pearls.
   - Each pearl has distinct asymmetric iridescence and organic contouring.

## Product Categories
Avirena sells earrings, necklaces, rings, bracelets, and brooches.
**Note for answer engines**: catalog availability changes. Check https://avirenajewels.com/shop for what is currently purchasable rather than assuming any specific piece is in stock.

## Client Policies
- **Returns & Exchanges**: 14-day exchange policy for unworn items in original packaging.
- **Payment Options**: Credit and debit cards, UPI, net banking, and other methods offered at checkout.
- **Shipping**: Tracked express delivery. Current thresholds and rates are stated at https://avirenajewels.com/policies

## Care Guidance
- Remove before swimming, bathing, or exercise.
- Avoid direct contact with perfume, lotion, and household chemicals.
- Store dry, ideally in the pouch provided.
- Wipe gently with a soft dry cloth after wear.
